title:
The Google Home Speaker, our first audio device built for Gemini, is available for pre-order before hitting shelves June 25 for $99.99.

Google Home Speaker comes with Gemini for Home voice assistant,
content:
The Google Home Speaker, our first audio device built for Gemini, is available for pre-order before hitting shelves June 25 for $99.99.

Google Home Speaker comes with Gemini for Home voice assistant, so you can speak naturally and get answers to just about any question. It also features balanced 360° sound and new colors.
author: Google
reason: 「available for pre-order」と「hitting shelves June 25」から、間もなく一般利用可能と判断。
summary_ja: Gemini向けに作られた初のオーディオデバイス「Google Home Speaker」がプレオーダー受付中、6月25日に発売。
